description: Amazon product records from search, category, and seller listings with price, rating, badges, and delivery details.

answeredQuestions.description: Answered-question count, only when the detail page renders it
answeredQuestions.title: Answered Questions

badge.description: Merchandising badge shown on the card (e.g. BestSeller, AmazonsChoice)
badge.title: Badge

bestsellerRanks.description: Bestseller rankings in different categories (JSON array)
bestsellerRanks.title: Bestseller Ranks

boughtInPastMonth.description: Number of units bought in the past month, parsed from the card's compact-count hint
boughtInPastMonth.title: Bought In Past Month

boughtInPastMonthText.description: Raw "X+ bought in past month" card text
boughtInPastMonthText.title: Bought In Past Month (raw text)

coupon.description: Coupon text shown on the card, if any
coupon.title: Coupon

currency.description: ISO currency code resolved from the product price, when available
currency.title: Currency

dealText.description: Raw deal/percent-off text shown on the listing card
dealText.title: Deal Text

deliveryEstimate.description: Estimated delivery text shown on the card
deliveryEstimate.title: Delivery Estimate

discountPercent.description: Discount percentage, calculated only from a genuine current price and strike-through list price
discountPercent.title: Discount Percent

facets.description: Refinement facets available on this results page (JSON array)
facets.title: Facets

fastestDelivery.description: Fastest delivery estimate, only when the detail page renders it
fastestDelivery.title: Fastest Delivery

features.description: List of product features and bullet points (JSON array)
features.title: Features

imageLarge.description: Largest product image URL available (upscaled Amazon media URL)
imageLarge.title: Large Image

images.description: All deduplicated image URLs for the product (JSON array)
images.title: Images

inStock.description: Whether the product is currently in stock
inStock.title: In Stock

listPrice.description: Genuine list/strike-through price only; never Amazon's "Typical price" reference
listPrice.title: List Price

locationText.description: Delivery destination the product detail page rendered for
locationText.title: Delivery Location

lowestOfferPrice.description: Lowest "More Buying Choices" offer price (JSON object with value and currency)
lowestOfferPrice.title: Lowest Offer Price

marketplace.description: Bare Amazon marketplace domain this record came from (e.g. amazon.com)
marketplace.title: Marketplace

moreOptionsText.description: Raw "More options" hint shown on the listing card
moreOptionsText.title: More Options Text

offerCount.description: Number of "More Buying Choices" offers shown on the card
offerCount.title: Offer Count

organicPosition.description: Position among organic results (sponsored rows are excluded from this count)
organicPosition.title: Organic Position

position.description: Position metadata (JSON object with page, positionOnPage, globalPosition, uuid)
position.title: Position

price.description: Current price (JSON object with value, currency, display)
price.title: Price

priceVariants.description: Per-variant price map, only when the detail page exposes one
priceVariants.title: Price Variants

prime.description: Whether the card shows an Amazon Prime badge (evidence-only)
prime.title: Prime

relatedSearches.description: Related search suggestions shown on this results page (JSON array of text/url pairs)
relatedSearches.title: Related Searches

resultType.description: Result classification: ORGANIC, SPONSORED, EDITORIAL, or OTHER
resultType.title: Result Type

resultsFrom.description: Starting result index reported by the results-info bar
resultsFrom.title: Results From

resultsTo.description: Ending result index reported by the results-info bar
resultsTo.title: Results To

resultsTotal.description: Total number of results reported by the results-info bar
resultsTotal.title: Results Total

returnPolicy.description: Return policy text, from the product detail page
returnPolicy.title: Return Policy

reviewsLink.description: Absolute link to the full reviews page, when available
reviewsLink.title: Reviews Link

scrapedAt.description: ISO timestamp when the data was scraped
scrapedAt.title: Scraped At

searchQuery.description: Keyword, node ID, or seller ID that produced this listing record
searchQuery.title: Search Query

seller.description: Seller identity {name, id, url}; omitted when no real seller ID can be resolved
seller.title: Seller

shippingPrice.description: Shipping cost when explicitly shown (0 means free shipping)
shippingPrice.title: Shipping Price

shipsTo.description: Ships-to location text shown on the card, if any
shipsTo.title: Ships To

soldByText.description: Raw "Sold by" line shown on the listing card
soldByText.title: Sold By Text

sourceLayout.description: Which page layout this card was extracted from: SEARCH_GRID, MERCHANDISING_LANDING, or MIXED
sourceLayout.title: Source Layout

sourceMode.description: Input mode that produced this record: keywords, categoryUrls, categoryNodeIds, sellerIds, asins, or productUrls
sourceMode.title: Source Mode

specifications.description: Deduplicated product specifications (JSON object), from the overview and technical-detail tables
specifications.title: Specifications

sponsored.description: Whether this result is a sponsored/ad placement (evidence-only)
sponsored.title: Sponsored

starsBreakdown.description: Rating breakdown by star count as a share per star, 0.0-1.0 (JSON object), from the product detail page when rendered
starsBreakdown.title: Rating Breakdown

stockText.description: Raw stock hint shown on the listing card
stockText.title: Stock Text

support.description: Support/warranty information, only when the detail page renders it
support.title: Support

sustainabilityFeatures.description: Sustainability/Climate Pledge Friendly badge labels (JSON array)
sustainabilityFeatures.title: Sustainability Features

typicalPrice.description: Amazon's separate "Typical price" reference price (never used as listPrice)
typicalPrice.title: Typical Price

unitPrice.description: Per-unit price text shown on the listing card
unitPrice.title: Unit Price

url.description: Direct Amazon URL for the product page
url.title: Product URL

variantAsins.description: List of variant product ASINs (JSON array)
variantAsins.title: Variant ASINs

variantAttributes.description: Visible variant dimensions (JSON array of {name, values}), when a twister widget exists
variantAttributes.title: Variant Attributes

variantsCount.description: Number of additional color/style variants shown via the card's "+N" hint
variantsCount.title: Variants Count

title: Amazon Search, Category & Seller Listings Extractor Output
